Description.Name: Das
Description.Details: A former Captain-General of the Free Worlds League and one of the few non-Mariks to hold the title, Das is rarely spoken about in the League, as she resided over its near-downfall. After leaving office, Das was revealed to be a member of the so-called 'New Wolverines', a group no one in the Inner Sphere is sure about. Whatever her origin, Das constantly finds herself blamed for everything that goes wrong around her, somehow even including a Sphere-wide 'Mech supercharger shortage.
